listing.name: AutoAttack/Patrol
listing.summary: AutoAttack/Patrol is a quality-of-life mod that automates some campaign map tasks by controlling the player fleet with an AI developed by yours truly.
listing.aiSummary: Automates campaign map tasks by controlling the player fleet with an AI.

description:
Why fly it yourself… when you can AutoAttack™?

Download Here

Tired of chasing down pirates one burn at a time? Sick of flying directly into suns and black holes? Let AutoAttack/Patrol do the heavy flying! So you can sit back, sip some coffee, and watch the kills rack up.

Features

AutoAttack/Patrol is a quality-of-life mod that automates some campaign map tasks by controlling the player fleet with an AI developed by yours truly.

Automatically hunts nearby enemies
The player fleet will scan the surrounding system for hostile fleets and move to engage them without manual input.

Avoids flying into stars and black holes
Custom pathfinding detects dangerous entities like suns or black holes and reroutes the fleet.

Patrols friendly space when idle
If no enemies are nearby, the fleet will automatically patrol around claimed planets, stations, and jump points.

In-game feedback via floating text
Displays floating messages above the player fleet to show when patrols are triggered, targets are engaged, or hazards are being avoided.

Instructions

Press Left Ctrl + 'p' to start the script.

Disclaimer
AutoAttack/Patrol comes with zero warranty, moral liability, or emotional support. We are not responsible for any unexpected loss of supplies, crew, ships, dignity, or entire fleets resulting from excessive trust in AI-driven autopilot.

Oh, and let's just say it’s more of a “sector-loving” feature. We recommend switching it off before diving into the warp soup.

Fly smart, captain. Or don’t. We’ll still be here… selling you upgrades.
